response.evidence: The surface charge density is defined as σ = q / (4πr²). For the bigger drop, Q = 64q and R = 4r, so σ_big = 64q / (4π(4r)²) = 64q / (64πr²) = q / (πr²). The ratio σ_big / σ_small = (q / πr²) / (q / 4πr²) = 4/1. The student incorrectly assumes that a larger area implies a lower density without accounting for the proportional increase in total charge.
